column1: # Single source of truth for the unit layout of this course.
# Used by scripts/scaffold.sh and the Makefile.
# The assigned text is Beltrami, Mathematics for Dynamic Modeling, in
# textbook/. Dr. Doty's notebooks are still the material that gets submitted.
# Titles below are read off the section headings inside the notebooks, so they
# are Doty's wording, not Beltrami's chapter titles. README.md carries the map
# between the two. Do not add a column here: scaffold.sh reads exactly four
# kind = lesson  -> Mathematica programming lessons ("Adv Lesson NN")
#                   Titled by number: the notebooks carry no title cell, and
#                   inventing one would be a lie.
# kind = chapter -> the "New Sect X.Y" notebook groups, numbered as Dr. Doty
#                   numbers them, which tracks Beltrami's chapter numbering.
#                   Beltrami chapters 4 and 9 have no notebooks and are absent.
